acceptance: Explicit disjoint source grants preserve sibling project and local-package topology in a private copy, with bounded capture and exact replay identity.

implementation.authority: Primary source grant plus at most eight exact canonical disjoint folder grants. Virtual common ancestor is never enumerated. Ungranted leaves, aliases, overlaps, credential folder roots and cross-root symlinks reject.
implementation.snapshot: Schema2 records original root identities, qualified private paths and exact per-root content digests including dirty/untracked files. Schema1 remains compatible. Shared entry/byte budgets cover each complete capture and original verification pass before file reads.
implementation.integration: Graph, rebasing, associated host preparation and retained reload use the same layout-relative project path. Ordinary PBXGroups may traverse bounded scaffold ancestors; actual file/package/synchronized roots require a grant. Native returned preparation must match queued build grants; saved fresh drafts retain those grants.
implementation.limits: Core explicit-grant API is implemented; native additional-folder picker remains missing. Captured tree revisions are content digests, not Git/submodule revisions. Remote/generated/macro/script/compiler consumption remains partial; copied builds are not a security sandbox.

installedSDKBuildOnly.assertions: App plus Shared sibling package plus transitive Leaf sibling package and external Extra.swift compile, saved preparation reloads, original trees remain identical. No runtime launch or intent dispatch.
installedSDKBuildOnly.initialFailure: First actual prepare failed before build due to stale primary-relative isolation path. Corrected to shared layout-relative path; original log retained separately.

verification.reviews: Two Sol lanes clear: root authority/capture privacy/shared bounds and graph/rebase/preparation/native queued approval/reload. Five findings corrected, including final SDK-caught path mismatch.

remaining: Full M0-M6 incomplete. Native extra-root selection, compiler-consumption provenance and existing live ownership/UI/Siri/controller/environment gates remain. No runtime capability promotion, push/publication/release.
